subject: Compact cross-region full loop — Michael Turner (BrightLayer) scheduling and panel sequencing
messages:
From: Lena Cho <lena.cho@recruitersplus.com>
To: irene_choi, laura_bennett, logan_wright, naomi_feldman, marissa_cole
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 16:38:00 -0800
Subject: BrightLayer — Michael Turner (candidate) — scheduling request

Hi team,

BrightLayer (Sanjay Iyer) asked us to compress Michael Turner's final loop into a single compact session next Friday. He is available:
- 2026-12-18, window A: 09:00–13:30 UTC (candidate is in IST but flexible)
- 2026-12-18, window B: 14:00–18:30 UTC (backup)

They explicitly asked for a condensed day (no more than ~3.5 hours on our side) due to travel constraints. Attached: Michael's resume and a suggested panel matrix from BrightLayer.

What we need from Redwood:
- panel sequencing (order of interviews to minimize context switching)
- confirmation of who can own the debrief and act as scribe for notes
- short buffer plan if an interviewer runs over (we should protect a 15-minute async window)

Can folks indicate availability for Window A and whether they can take scribe/debrief?

Thanks,
Lena
(recruiter)

Attachments: candidate_resume_mturner.pdf
From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett, logan_wright, naomi_feldman, marissa_cole
Cc: Lena Cho <lena.cho@recruitersplus.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BrightLayer — Michael Turner (candidate) — scheduling request

Thanks, Lena — forwarding to the core panel.

My quick proposal to keep the loop compact and signal breadth:
1) System design (30m) — Logan — start of block (we want a fresh, unsolved problem first)
2) Product / role-fit discussion (25m) — Laura — link to team priorities and customer context
3) Pair problem / take-home interactive (40m) — Naomi + Marissa (pairing required)
4) People/leadership / cultural fit (20m) — me (closing)

Total: 1h 55m of interviews + 15m buffer + 30m debrief = ~3h 10m. That meets the ask.

Operational asks:
- Can someone take scribe and run the debrief doc at the end? Preferably an IC who wasn't in pair problem.
- Please confirm availability for Window A (09:00–13:30 UTC). If any conflicts, call out precise timezone constraints and we can flip to Window B.

I attached a compact panel matrix I sketched for timings and roles. If we agree, I'll send the invites to Michael and the BrightLayer hiring team.

— Irene
VP, Hiring Operations
Redwood Inference

This order looks good. Two small asks from my side:

If Window A starts at 09:00 UTC, that would put System Design 09:05–09:35 UTC, Product 09:45–10:10 UTC, Pair 10:20–11:00 UTC.
- Naomi, Marissa — please confirm you can both join for the whole pair session and that one of you is comfortable leading the shared screen exercise.

- Recommend we block a 30-minute cold-debrief immediately after the candidate (no feedback forms during that window) so we can hit consensus quickly. If anyone needs to drop, we'll do an extended async debrief doc with clear owner.
